summary.short: Colombian bill (Senate 247/2024S, House 359/2025C; Ley Ordinaria) with the stated object of adopting awareness, prevention, protection, reparation and penalisation measures against digital gender-based violence in public and private digital environments. Still in House committee; the document contains no operative articles.
summary.long: The document is the Congress of Colombia's bill record page for Proyecto de Ley 247 de 2024 Senado / 359 de 2025 Cámara, a Ley Ordinaria titled as a law on comprehensive protection against digital gender-based violence. Its stated object is to adopt measures of awareness, prevention, protection and reparation, and to penalise conduct of digital gender-based violence carried out through ICT, so as to secure human dignity, privacy and a life free of violence in digital environments, in both public and private settings. The record shows Senate filing on 24/9/2024, House filing on 23/9/2025, a Senate-approved text (Gaceta 1732/25), and that the bill is in the Comisión Primera Constitucional Permanente, with a public hearing on 24 November 2025 and a positive first-debate report (Gaceta 432/2026). The page reproduces no articles, so the mechanisms, obligations, thresholds, sanctions and entry-into-force date cannot be coded from it and are not stated in this record. Classification is limited to the stated object and the bill type.

notes: The document is a legislative status page for the bill (Senate No. 247/2024S, Chamber No. 359/2025C) with metadata and a summary of its object only. It does not contain the operative articles, so no relations, obligations or thresholds could be coded. The page refers to the 'Texto Aprobado en Plenaria del Senado' (Gaceta 1732/25) but does not reproduce that text. It names no other instrument that the bill amends, repeals, implements or cross-references, so no relation rows are recorded.
